Alex (ML Eng): quick heads-up — after HF->Redwood conversion of galactica-mini-v2 the system prompt tokenization changed and our chat evals regressed ~8% on convbench.
Priya (ML Eval): can you paste a minimal repro? is this unicode normalizer or pre-tokenizer mismatch?
Alex (ML Eng): repro below. converted with tokenizer from HF tokenizers (use_fast=True). seems like `add_prefix_space` got lost. quick compare:
```py
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("galactica-mini-v2", use_fast=True)
print(t.encode("You are a helpful assistant."))
print(t.encode(" You are a helpful assistant."))
```
On HF this yields two different token sequences as expected, but the converted Redwood tokenizer treats both the same (no prefix space), which collapses leading-space-sensitive chat templates.
Jonas (Infra): hmm — check tokenizer.json normalizer + pre_tokenizer. HF ByteLevelTokenizers rely on `add_prefix_space` to preserve leading spaces. If the conversion script ignores `tokenizer.add_prefix_space` it will break system/user boundary tokens.
Priya (ML Eval): yes — our chat templates use "system\n<system_message>\n---\nuser" and rely on prefix spacing to separate roles. When prefix is stripped, user token indices shift which breaks evals and length estimates.
Eli (SRE): any quantization angle? could quant amplify the effect?
Alex (ML Eng): good point — when we ran 4-bit quant we saw decoder attention alignment slightly different and combined with token index mismatch produced worse generative quality. But root cause is pre-tokenizer mismatch.
Alex (ML Eng): current quick fix: re-save tokenizer with `add_prefix_space=True` and ensure normalizer is NFKC (the HF tokenizer had it). small script:
```bash
python - <<'PY'
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
hf = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("galactica-mini-v2", use_fast=True)
hf.save_pretrained("/tmp/gmini_tok")
# quick manual patch to tokenizer.json: set "add_prefix_space": true under model config
PY
```
Priya (ML Eval): we patched conversion tool to copy `tokenizer.json` fields: `add_prefix_space`, `normalizer` type, `pre_tokenizer` type, and `post_processor`. re-ran evals — regression gone, perplexity and LLM-Suite metrics back to baseline.
Jonas (Infra): added a unit test in conversion CI: tokenizes `"Hello"` vs `" Hello"` and expect different token ids. also added a smoke test for chat template roundtrip.
deploy-bot: conversion-job-342 finished (status: success) :rocket:
Priya (ML Eval): action items: 1) land conversion fix + tests, 2) re-run quantized evals (4-bit/3-bit) to verify no amplifying regressions, 3) add a small docs note about `add_prefix_space` for future model onboarding.
Alex (ML Eng): agreed. will open PR with patch and evaluation results.
Eli (SRE): :thumbsup: let me know when CI clears and I'll promote to dedicated staging pool.
Priya (ML Eval): thanks everyone — saved us a lot of debugging time :relieved:
